visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young male with short black hair wearing a black t-shirt sits behind a large white plush mascot with blue details on its head. (3) The man returns to the frame, sitting behind the mascot, and continues explaining with active hand gestures. (4) A list of shop locations in Taiwan is displayed on a full screen with white background and colored headings. (5) The man is shown again behind the mascot, gesturing towards it. (10) Yellow transition screen with '這次合作是一次性嗎?'. (11) The man leans fully onto the mascot to demonstrate its softness and plushiness while talking. (12) Yellow screen transition with '這次沒抽會在文博有嗎? 還是其他地方呢?'. (13) The man is shown speaking intently towards the camera. (14) Yellow transition screen with 'A賞太大很困擾帶不走怎麼辦?'. (17) The man gives a concluding summary, looking into the camera. (18) The location list is shown again as a final reference.
